# JDC Construction

> JDC Construction is a custom home builder and remodeler based in Lawrenceburg, Indiana (25505 Steele Rd, 47025), serving Dearborn County, Southeast Indiana and Greater Cincinnati since 1996. Owners: Jason and Lisa Cox. Phone: (812) 637-2684. Credentials: Graduate Master Builder, Graduate Master Remodeler, Certified Graduate Remodeler, Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist, Certified Green Professional; 2019 Indiana Remodeler of the Year.

## Services
- [Custom homes](https://jdcremodeling.com/custom-home.html): fully custom homes built from the ground up
- [Finding land to build on](https://jdcremodeling.com/finding-land-to-build-southeast-indiana.html): what to check before buying a lot
- [Custom home FAQ](https://jdcremodeling.com/custom-home-faq.html): cost, timeline, land, permits, warranty
- [Build on your own lot](https://jdcremodeling.com/build-on-your-lot-southeast-indiana.html): how JDC builds a custom home on land you already own
- [Custom home building process](https://jdcremodeling.com/custom-home-process.html): step-by-step build process
- [Custom home portfolio](https://jdcremodeling.com/custom-home-portfolio.html): completed projects
- [Remodeling](https://jdcremodeling.com/remodeling.html): kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home remodels, additions
- [Kitchen remodeling](https://jdcremodeling.com/remodeling-kitchen.html)
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://jdcremodeling.com/remodeling-bathroom.html)
